title: MCCH information validity and notification of changes

entities.name: Multicast Control Channel
entities.description: Channel carrying multicast control information for MBS services. Its information changes only at specific modification periods.

entities.name: Modification Period
entities.description: Time period during which MCCH information remains unchanged. Changes occur only at specific radio frames within this period.

entities.name: Repetition Period
entities.description: Scheduling period defining how many times the same MCCH information is transmitted within a modification period.

entities.name: MCCH Change Notification
entities.description: Notification sent via PDCCH to inform UEs about changes in MCCH information. Uses a 2-bit bitmap to indicate different change types.

entities.name: 2-bit Notification Bitmap
entities.description: Bitmap where MSB=1 indicates start of new MBS service(s) and LSB=1 indicates modification of MCCH information excluding new service starts.

entities.name: MBS Service Start
entities.description: Condition indicated when MSB of notification bitmap is set to '1', signaling the start of new MBS service(s).

entities.name: MCCH Information Modification
entities.description: Condition indicated when LSB of notification bitmap is set to '1', covering configuration changes, session stops, or neighboring cell information modifications.

entities.name: UE Receiving MBS Services
entities.description: State where UE is currently receiving or interested in receiving MBS services via broadcast.

relations.description: MCCH information changes only occur at specific radio frames within modification periods.
MCCH information scheduling is based on repetition periods within modification periods.
Change notification message contains the 2-bit bitmap indicating change types.
MSB=1 in bitmap indicates start of new MBS service(s).
LSB=1 in bitmap indicates MCCH information modification excluding new service starts.
UE receiving or interested in MBS services acquires new MCCH information upon receiving change notification.
